This pass covered the disabled large-proposal test at feasible sizes and re-ran the full default matrix.

**New this pass**

- **Large payloads** (`TestAuditLargeProposal`): the upstream `TestLargeProposalCanBeProposed` is commented out because it allocates 8 GB. I exercised the same path at 1 MB, 8 MB and 32 MB, with and without Snappy, on a single node. Every proposal commits and the state machine observes the exact payload length (32 MB: ~289 ms uncompressed, ~85 ms Snappy).
- **Large payloads over the network** (`TestAuditLargeProposalTwoNodes`): 8 MB (~131 ms) and 32 MB (~1.0 s) committed across a two-NodeHost cluster, exercising message-batch marshaling, TCP framing and the receiver queue.
- **Final default matrix**: `./internal/raft ./internal/rsm ./internal/logdb ./internal/server ./tools ./client ./config ./raftpb .` all pass in the isolated namespace.

Both new checks are negative results and are recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md), which now also has a three-command “quick verification” block for the findings.
